## admin_apps_list

<a id="opIdadmin_apps_list"></a>

> Code samples

```bash

  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /admin/apps/`

Read-only view list all installed apps

## admin_file_create

<a id="opIdadmin_file_create"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://authentik.example.com/api/v3/admin/file/ \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -F 'file=@/path/to/file' \
  -F 'name=string' \
  -F 'usage=media'
```

`POST /admin/file/`

Upload file to storage backend.

> Body parameter

```yaml
file: string
name: string
usage: media
```

## admin_settings_update

<a id="opIdadmin_settings_update"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://authentik.example.com/api/v3/admin/settings/ \
  -X PUT \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "avatars": "string",
    "base_url": "http://example.com",
    "default_user_change_name": true,
    "default_user_change_email": true,
    "default_user_change_username": true,
    "event_retention": "string",
    "reputation_lower_limit": -2147483648,
    "reputation_upper_limit": 0,
    "footer_links": null,
    "gdpr_compliance": true,
    "impersonation": true,
    "impersonation_require_reason": true,
    "default_token_duration": "string",
    "default_token_length": 1,
    "pagination_default_page_size": 0,
    "pagination_max_page_size": 0,
    "flags": {
      "core_default_app_access": true,
      "enterprise_audit_include_expanded_diff": true,
      "flows_continuous_login": true
    }
  }'
```

`PUT /admin/settings/`

Settings view

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "avatars": "string",
  "base_url": "http://example.com",
  "default_user_change_name": true,
  "default_user_change_email": true,
  "default_user_change_username": true,
  "event_retention": "string",
  "reputation_lower_limit": -2147483648,
  "reputation_upper_limit": 0,
  "footer_links": null,
  "gdpr_compliance": true,
  "impersonation": true,
  "impersonation_require_reason": true,
  "default_token_duration": "string",
  "default_token_length": 1,
  "pagination_default_page_size": 0,
  "pagination_max_page_size": 0,
  "flags": {
    "core_default_app_access": true,
    "enterprise_audit_include_expanded_diff": true,
    "flows_continuous_login": true
  }
}
```

<h3 id="adminsettingsupdate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[SettingsRequest](#schemasettingsrequest)|true|none|
|» avatars|body|string|false|Configure how authentik should show avatars for users.|
|» base_url|body|string(uri)|false|Configure the base URL under which this authentik instance is reachable, e.g. https://authentik.company|
|» default_user_change_name|body|boolean|false|Enable the ability for users to change their name.|
|» default_user_change_email|body|boolean|false|Enable the ability for users to change their email address.|
|» default_user_change_username|body|boolean|false|Enable the ability for users to change their username.|
|» event_retention|body|string|false|Events will be deleted after this duration.(Format: weeks=3;days=2;hours=3,seconds=2).|
|» reputation_lower_limit|body|integer|false|Reputation cannot decrease lower than this value. Zero or negative.|
|» reputation_upper_limit|body|integer|false|Reputation cannot increase higher than this value. Zero or positive.|
|» footer_links|body|object|false|none|
|» gdpr_compliance|body|boolean|false|When enabled, all the events caused by a user will be deleted upon the user's deletion.|
|» impersonation|body|boolean|false|Globally enable/disable impersonation.|
|» impersonation_require_reason|body|boolean|false|Require administrators to provide a reason for impersonating a user.|
|» default_token_duration|body|string|false|Default token duration|
|» default_token_length|body|integer|false|Default token length|
|» pagination_default_page_size|body|integer|false|Default page size for API responses, if no size was requested.|
|» pagination_max_page_size|body|integer|false|Maximum page size|
|» flags|body|object|true|none|
|» » core_default_app_access|body|boolean|true|Applications with no policies bound can be accessed by any user.|
|» » enterprise_audit_include_expanded_diff|body|boolean|true|Include additional information in audit logs, may incur a performance penalty.|
|» » flows_continuous_login|body|boolean|true|Upon successful authentication, re-start authentication in other open tabs.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "avatars": "string",
  "base_url": "http://example.com",
  "default_user_change_name": true,
  "default_user_change_email": true,
  "default_user_change_username": true,
  "event_retention": "string",
  "reputation_lower_limit": -2147483648,
  "reputation_upper_limit": 0,
  "footer_links": null,
  "gdpr_compliance": true,
  "impersonation": true,
  "impersonation_require_reason": true,
  "default_token_duration": "string",
  "default_token_length": 1,
  "pagination_default_page_size": 0,
  "pagination_max_page_size": 0,
  "flags": {
    "core_default_app_access": true,
    "enterprise_audit_include_expanded_diff": true,
    "flows_continuous_login": true
  }
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "non_field_errors": [
    "string"
  ],
  "code": "string",
  "property1": null,
  "property2": null
}
```

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "detail": "string",
  "code": "string"
}
```

```bash
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "password": "string",
    "override": false
  }'
```

`POST /core/users/{id}/set_password_hash/`

Set a user's password from a pre-hashed Django password value.

Submit the Django password hash in the shared ``password`` request field.

This updates authentik's local password verifier only. It does not attempt
to propagate the password change to LDAP or Kerberos because no raw password
is available from the request payload.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "password": "string",
  "override": false
}
```

<h3 id="coreuserssetpasswordhashcreate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|integer|true|A unique integer value identifying this User.|
|body|body|[UserPasswordHashSetRequest](#schemauserpasswordhashsetrequest)|true|none|
|» password|body|string|true|none|
|» override|body|boolean|false|Import a valid password hash even when its parameters do not match authentik's current password hashing settings.|

> Example responses

> 403 Response

```json
{
  "detail": "string",
  "code": "string"
}
```

<h3 id="coreuserssetpasswordhashcreate-responses">Responses</h3>

## core_users_export_create

<a id="opIdcore_users_export_create"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://authentik.example.com/api/v3/core/users/export/ \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`POST /core/users/export/`

Create a data export for this data type. Note that the export is generated asynchronously:
this method returns a `DataExport` object that will initially have `completed=false` as well
as the permanent URL to that object in the `Location` header.
You can poll that URL until `completed=true`, at which point the `file_url` property will
contain a URL to download

|date_joined__lt|query|string(date-time)|false|none|
|email|query|string|false|none|

|groups_by_pk|query|[string(uuid)]|false|none|
|is_active|query|boolean|false|none|
|is_superuser|query|boolean|false|none|
|last_login|query|string(date-time)|false|none|
|last_login__gt|query|string(date-time)|false|none|
|last_login__isnull|query|boolean|false|none|
|last_login__lt|query|string(date-time)|false|none|
|last_updated|query|string(date-time)|false|none|
|last_updated__gt|query|string(date-time)|false|none|
|last_updated__lt|query|string(date-time)|false|none|
|name|query|string|false|none|
|ordering|query|string|false|Which field to use when ordering the results.|
|path|query|string|false|none|
|path_startswith|query|string|false|none|
|roles_by_name|query|[string]|false|none|
|roles_by_pk|query|[string(uuid)]|false|none|

```bash
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /enterprise/license/user_counts/`

Get active user totals and counts for relative or absolute date ranges.

At least one positive relative count step or a complete absolute range is required.
Relative and absolute ranges may be combined. Range starts are inclusive and ends are
exclusive. Counts include currently active, non-anonymous accounts.

<h3 id="enterpriselicenseusercountsretrieve-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|count_steps|query|[string]|false|Positive relative periods, such as 'days=30' or 'weeks=3;days=2'.|
|end|query|string(date-time)|false|Exclusive end of an absolute range; must be provided with start.|
|start|query|string(date-time)|false|Inclusive start of an absolute range; must be provided with end.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "active_internal_users": 0,
  "active_external_users": 0,
  "ranges": [
    {
      "start": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "end": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "interval": "string",
      "internal_users_added": 0,
      "external_users_added": 0
    }
  ]
}
```

```json
    "string"
  ],

}
```

Create a data export for this data type. Note that the export is generated asynchronously:
this method returns a `DataExport` object that will initially have `completed=false` as well

## flows_executor_solve

<a id="opIdflows_executor_solve"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'https://authentik.example.com/api/v3/flows/executor/string/?query=string' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "component": "ak-source-oauth-apple"
  }'
```

`POST /flows/executor/{flow_slug}/`

Solve the previously retrieved challenge and advanced to the next stage.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "component": "ak-source-oauth-apple"
}
```

<h3 id="flowsexecutorsolve-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|flow_slug|path|string|true|none|
|query|query|string|true|Querystring as received|
|body|body|[FlowChallengeResponseRequest](#schemaflowchallengeresponserequest)|false|none|
|» *oneOf*|body|[AppleChallengeResponseRequest](#schemaapplechallengeresponserequest)|false|Pseudo class for apple response|
|» *oneOf*|body|[AuthenticatorDuoChallengeResponseRequest](#schemaauthenticatorduochallengeresponserequest)|false|Pseudo class for duo response|
|» *oneOf*|body|[AuthenticatorEmailChallengeResponseRequest](#schemaauthenticatoremailchallengeresponserequest)|false|Authenticator Email Challenge response, device is set by get_response_instance|
|» *oneOf*|body|[AuthenticatorSMSChallengeResponseRequest](#schemaauthenticatorsmschallengeresponserequest)|false|SMS Challenge response, device is set by get_response_instance|
|» *oneOf*|body|[AuthenticatorStaticChallengeResponseRequest](#schemaauthenticatorstaticchallengeresponserequest)|false|Pseudo class for static response|
|» *oneOf*|body|[AuthenticatorTOTPChallengeResponseRequest](#schemaauthenticatortotpchallengeresponserequest)|false|TOTP Challenge response, device is set by get_response_instance|
|» *oneOf*|body|[AuthenticatorValidationChallengeResponseRequest](#schemaauthenticatorvalidationchallengeresponserequest)|false|Challenge used for Code-based and WebAuthn authenticators|
|» *oneOf*|body|[AuthenticatorWebAuthnChallengeResponseRequest](#schemaauthenticatorwebauthnchallengeresponserequest)|false|WebAuthn Challenge response|
|» *oneOf*|body|[AutoSubmitChallengeResponseRequest](#schemaautosubmitchallengeresponserequest)|false|Pseudo class for autosubmit response|
|» *oneOf*|body|[CaptchaChallengeResponseRequest](#schemacaptchachallengeresponserequest)|false|Validate captcha token|
|» *oneOf*|body|[ConsentChallengeResponseRequest](#schemaconsentchallengeresponserequest)|false|Consent challenge response, any valid response request is valid|
|» *oneOf*|body|[DummyChallengeResponseRequest](#schemadummychallengeresponserequest)|false|Dummy challenge response|
|» *oneOf*|body|[EmailChallengeResponseRequest](#schemaemailchallengeresponserequest)|false|Email challenge resposen. No fields. This challenge is<br>always declared invalid to give the user a chance to retry|
|» *oneOf*|body|[EndpointAgentChallengeResponseRequest](#schemaendpointagentchallengeresponserequest)|false|Response to signed challenge|
|» *oneOf*|body|[FrameChallengeResponseRequest](#schemaframechallengeresponserequest)|false|Base class for all challenge responses|
|» *oneOf*|body|[IdentificationChallengeResponseRequest](#schemaidentificationchallengeresponserequest)|false|Identification challenge|
|» *oneOf*|body|[IframeLogoutChallengeResponseRequest](#schemaiframelogoutchallengeresponserequest)|false|Response for iframe logout|
|» *oneOf*|body|[NativeLogoutChallengeResponseRequest](#schemanativelogoutchallengeresponserequest)|false|Response for native browser logout|
|» *oneOf*|body|[OAuthDeviceCodeChallengeResponseRequest](#schemaoauthdevicecodechallengeresponserequest)|false|Response that includes the user-entered device code|
|» *oneOf*|body|[OAuthDeviceCodeFinishChallengeResponseRequest](#schemaoauthdevicecodefinishchallengeresponserequest)|false|Response that device has been authenticated and tab can be closed|
|» *oneOf*|body|[PasswordChallengeResponseRequest](#schemapasswordchallengeresponserequest)|false|Password challenge response|
|» *oneOf*|body|[PlexAuthenticationChallengeResponseRequest](#schemaplexauthenticationchallengeresponserequest)|false|Pseudo class for plex response|
|» *oneOf*|body|[PromptChallengeResponseRequest](#schemapromptchallengeresponserequest)|false|Validate response, fields are dynamically created based<br>on the stage|
|» *oneOf*|body|[RedirectChallengeResponseRequest](#schemaredirectchallengeresponserequest)|false|Redirect challenge response|
|» *oneOf*|body|[TelegramChallengeResponseRequest](#schematelegramchallengeresponserequest)|false|Base class for all challenge responses|
|» *oneOf*|body|[UserLoginChallengeResponseRequest](#schemauserloginchallengeresponserequest)|false|User login challenge|

## lifecycle_user_offboarding_destroy

<a id="opIdlifecycle_user_offboarding_destroy"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://authentik.example.com/api/v3/lifecycle/user_offboarding/497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08/ \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /lifecycle/user_offboarding/{id}/`

Cancel a pending offboarding instead of deleting the record.

The row is retained (as `CANCELED`) so the offboarding stays visible in
the audit history; deletion would erase who scheduled and cancelled it.
You cannot cancel an offboarding that targets you.

<h3 id="lifecycleuseroffboardingdestroy-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|id|path|string(uuid)|true|A UUID string identifying this User Offboarding.|

<h3 id="providerssamlcreate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[SAMLProviderRequest](#schemasamlproviderrequest)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|none|
|» authentication_flow|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Flow used for authentication when the associated application is accessed by an un-authenticated user.|
|» authorization_flow|body|string(uuid)|true|Flow used when authorizing this provider.|
|» invalidation_flow|body|string(uuid)|true|Flow used ending the session from a provider.|
|» property_mappings|body|[string(uuid)]|false|none|
|» acs_url|body|string(uri)|true|none|
|» sls_url|body|string(uri)|false|Single Logout Service URL where the logout response should be sent.|
|» audience|body|string|false|Value of the audience restriction field of the assertion. When left empty, no audience restriction will be added.|
|» issuer_override|body|string|false|Also known as EntityID. Providing a value overrides the default issuer generated by authentik.|
|» assertion_valid_not_before|body|string|false|Assertion valid not before current time + this value (Format: hours=-1;minutes=-2;seconds=-3).|
|» assertion_valid_not_on_or_after|body|string|false|Assertion not valid on or after current time + this value (Format: hours=1;minutes=2;seconds=3).|
|» session_valid_not_on_or_after|body|string|false|Session not valid on or after current time + this value (Format: hours=1;minutes=2;seconds=3).|
|» name_id_mapping|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Configure how the NameID value will be created. When left empty, the NameIDPolicy of the incoming request will be considered|
|» authn_context_class_ref_mapping|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Configure how the AuthnContextClassRef value will be created. When left empty, the AuthnContextClassRef will be set based on which authentication methods the user used to authenticate.|
|» digest_algorithm|body|[DigestAlgorithmEnum](#schemadigestalgorithmenum)|false|none|
|» signature_algorithm|body|[SignatureAlgorithmEnum](#schemasignaturealgorithmenum)|false|none|
|» signing_kp|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Keypair used to sign outgoing Responses going to the Service Provider.|
|» verification_kp|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|When selected, incoming assertion's Signatures will be validated against this certificate. To allow unsigned Requests, leave on default.|
|» encryption_kp|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|When selected, incoming assertions are encrypted by the IdP using the public key of the encryption keypair. The assertion is decrypted by the SP using the the private key.|
|» encryption_algorithm|body|object|false|Block cipher used to encrypt the assertion.|
|» sign_assertion|body|boolean|false|none|
|» sign_response|body|boolean|false|none|
|» sign_logout_request|body|boolean|false|none|
|» sign_logout_response|body|boolean|false|none|
|» sp_binding|body|object|false|This determines how authentik sends the response back to the Service Provider.|
|» sls_binding|body|object|false|This determines how authentik sends the logout response back to the Service Provider.|
|» logout_method|body|object|false|Method to use for logout. Front-channel iframe loads all logout URLs simultaneously in hidden iframes. Front-channel native uses your active browser tab to send post requests and redirect to providers. Back-channel sends logout requests directly from the server without user interaction (requires POST SLS binding).|
|» default_relay_state|body|string|false|Default relay_state value for IDP-initiated logins|
|» default_name_id_policy|body|[SAMLNameIDPolicyEnum](#schemasamlnameidpolicyenum)|false|none|
|» jwt_federation_providers|body|[integer]|false|OAuth2 providers which can exchange their JWTs for a SAML Response of this provider via token exchange.|

<h3 id="providerssamlupdate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|path|integer|true|A unique integer value identifying this SAML Provider.|
|body|body|[SAMLProviderRequest](#schemasamlproviderrequest)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|none|
|» authentication_flow|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Flow used for authentication when the associated application is accessed by an un-authenticated user.|
|» authorization_flow|body|string(uuid)|true|Flow used when authorizing this provider.|
|» invalidation_flow|body|string(uuid)|true|Flow used ending the session from a provider.|
|» property_mappings|body|[string(uuid)]|false|none|
|» acs_url|body|string(uri)|true|none|
|» sls_url|body|string(uri)|false|Single Logout Service URL where the logout response should be sent.|
|» audience|body|string|false|Value of the audience restriction field of the assertion. When left empty, no audience restriction will be added.|
|» issuer_override|body|string|false|Also known as EntityID. Providing a value overrides the default issuer generated by authentik.|
|» assertion_valid_not_before|body|string|false|Assertion valid not before current time + this value (Format: hours=-1;minutes=-2;seconds=-3).|
|» assertion_valid_not_on_or_after|body|string|false|Assertion not valid on or after current time + this value (Format: hours=1;minutes=2;seconds=3).|
|» session_valid_not_on_or_after|body|string|false|Session not valid on or after current time + this value (Format: hours=1;minutes=2;seconds=3).|
|» name_id_mapping|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Configure how the NameID value will be created. When left empty, the NameIDPolicy of the incoming request will be considered|
|» authn_context_class_ref_mapping|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Configure how the AuthnContextClassRef value will be created. When left empty, the AuthnContextClassRef will be set based on which authentication methods the user used to authenticate.|
|» digest_algorithm|body|[DigestAlgorithmEnum](#schemadigestalgorithmenum)|false|none|
|» signature_algorithm|body|[SignatureAlgorithmEnum](#schemasignaturealgorithmenum)|false|none|
|» signing_kp|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Keypair used to sign outgoing Responses going to the Service Provider.|
|» verification_kp|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|When selected, incoming assertion's Signatures will be validated against this certificate. To allow unsigned Requests, leave on default.|
|» encryption_kp|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|When selected, incoming assertions are encrypted by the IdP using the public key of the encryption keypair. The assertion is decrypted by the SP using the the private key.|
|» encryption_algorithm|body|object|false|Block cipher used to encrypt the assertion.|
|» sign_assertion|body|boolean|false|none|
|» sign_response|body|boolean|false|none|
|» sign_logout_request|body|boolean|false|none|
|» sign_logout_response|body|boolean|false|none|
|» sp_binding|body|object|false|This determines how authentik sends the response back to the Service Provider.|
|» sls_binding|body|object|false|This determines how authentik sends the logout response back to the Service Provider.|
|» logout_method|body|object|false|Method to use for logout. Front-channel iframe loads all logout URLs simultaneously in hidden iframes. Front-channel native uses your active browser tab to send post requests and redirect to providers. Back-channel sends logout requests directly from the server without user interaction (requires POST SLS binding).|
|» default_relay_state|body|string|false|Default relay_state value for IDP-initiated logins|
|» default_name_id_policy|body|[SAMLNameIDPolicyEnum](#schemasamlnameidpolicyenum)|false|none|
|» jwt_federation_providers|body|[integer]|false|OAuth2 providers which can exchange their JWTs for a SAML Response of this provider via token exchange.|

|» session_valid_not_on_or_after|body|string|false|Session not valid on or after current time + this value (Format: hours=1;minutes=2;seconds=3).|
|» name_id_mapping|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Configure how the NameID value will be created. When left empty, the NameIDPolicy of the incoming request will be considered|
|» authn_context_class_ref_mapping|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Configure how the AuthnContextClassRef value will be created. When left empty, the AuthnContextClassRef will be set based on which authentication methods the user used to authenticate.|
|» digest_algorithm|body|[DigestAlgorithmEnum](#schemadigestalgorithmenum)|false|none|
|» signature_algorithm|body|[SignatureAlgorithmEnum](#schemasignaturealgorithmenum)|false|none|
|» signing_kp|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Keypair used to sign outgoing Responses going to the Service Provider.|
|» verification_kp|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|When selected, incoming assertion's Signatures will be validated against this certificate. To allow unsigned Requests, leave on default.|
|» encryption_kp|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|When selected, incoming assertions are encrypted by the IdP using the public key of the encryption keypair. The assertion is decrypted by the SP using the the private key.|
|» encryption_algorithm|body|object|false|Block cipher used to encrypt the assertion.|
|» sign_assertion|body|boolean|false|none|
|» sign_response|body|boolean|false|none|
|» sign_logout_request|body|boolean|false|none|
|» sign_logout_response|body|boolean|false|none|
|» sp_binding|body|object|false|This determines how authentik sends the response back to the Service Provider.|
|» sls_binding|body|object|false|This determines how authentik sends the logout response back to the Service Provider.|
|» logout_method|body|object|false|Method to use for logout. Front-channel iframe loads all logout URLs simultaneously in hidden iframes. Front-channel native uses your active browser tab to send post requests and redirect to providers. Back-channel sends logout requests directly from the server without user interaction (requires POST SLS binding).|
|» default_relay_state|body|string|false|Default relay_state value for IDP-initiated logins|
|» default_name_id_policy|body|[SAMLNameIDPolicyEnum](#schemasamlnameidpolicyenum)|false|none|
|» jwt_federation_providers|body|[integer]|false|OAuth2 providers which can exchange their JWTs for a SAML Response of this provider via token exchange.|

## requests_grant_requests_agent_create

<a id="opIdrequests_grant_requests_agent_create"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://authentik.example.com/api/v3/requests/grant-requests/agent/ \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "pbms": [
      "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /requests/grant-requests/agent/`

Delegate access an agent's owner already holds to the agent, time-boxed. Unlike
`create` this persists the request directly instead of returning a flow link -- an agent
authenticates with an API token and has no browser to run a flow in, so no justification
is ever collected. That is why the agent may only ask for what its owner already has:
the owner's approval is then the whole decision, and no reviewer is asked to judge a
request with nothing in it. The returned `fulfill_url` is what the agent hands to its
owner so they can act on it.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "pbms": [
    "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="requestsgrantrequestsagentcreate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[AgentGrantRequestCreateRequest](#schemaagentgrantrequestcreaterequest)|true|none|
|» pbms|body|[string(uuid)]|true|none|

|» name|body|string|true|Source's display Name.|
|» slug|body|string|true|Internal source name, used in URLs.|
|» enabled|body|boolean|false|none|
|» promoted|body|boolean|false|When enabled, this source will be displayed as a prominent button on the login page, instead of a small icon.|
|» authentication_flow|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Flow to use when authenticating existing users.|
|» enrollment_flow|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Flow to use when enrolling new users.|
|» user_property_mappings|body|[string(uuid)]|false|none|
|» group_property_mappings|body|[string(uuid)]|false|none|
|» policy_engine_mode|body|[PolicyEngineMode](#schemapolicyenginemode)|false|none|
|» user_matching_mode|body|object|false|How the source determines if an existing user should be authenticated or a new user enrolled.|
|» user_path_template|body|string|false|none|
|» icon|body|string|false|none|
|» group_matching_mode|body|object|false|How the source determines if an existing group should be used or a new group created.|
|» realm|body|string|true|Kerberos realm|
|» krb5_conf|body|string|false|Custom krb5.conf to use. Uses the system one by default|
|» kadmin_type|body|object|false|KAdmin server type|
|» sync_users|body|boolean|false|Sync users from Kerberos into authentik|
|» sync_users_password|body|boolean|false|When a user changes their password, sync it back to Kerberos|
|» sync_principal|body|string|false|Principal to authenticate to kadmin for sync.|
|» sync_password|body|string|false|Password to authenticate to kadmin for sync|
|» sync_keytab|body|string|false|Keytab to authenticate to kadmin for sync. Must be base64-encoded or in the form TYPE:residual|
|» sync_ccache|body|string|false|Credentials cache to authenticate to kadmin for sync. Must be in the form TYPE:residual|
|» spnego_server_name|body|string|false|Force the use of a specific server name for SPNEGO. Must be in the form HTTP@hostname|
|» spnego_keytab|body|string|false|SPNEGO keytab base64-encoded or path to keytab in the form FILE:path|
|» spnego_ccache|body|string|false|Credential cache to use for SPNEGO in form type:residual|
|» password_login_update_internal_password|body|boolean|false|If enabled, the authentik-stored password will be updated upon login with the Kerberos password backend|
|» sync_outgoing_trigger_mode|body|object|false|When to trigger sync for outgoing providers|

<h3 id="sourcesldapcreate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[LDAPSourceRequest](#schemaldapsourcerequest)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|Source's display Name.|
|» slug|body|string|true|Internal source name, used in URLs.|
|» enabled|body|boolean|false|none|
|» promoted|body|boolean|false|When enabled, this source will be displayed as a prominent button on the login page, instead of a small icon.|
|» authentication_flow|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Flow to use when authenticating existing users.|
|» enrollment_flow|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Flow to use when enrolling new users.|
|» user_property_mappings|body|[string(uuid)]|false|none|
|» group_property_mappings|body|[string(uuid)]|false|none|
|» policy_engine_mode|body|[PolicyEngineMode](#schemapolicyenginemode)|false|none|
|» user_matching_mode|body|object|false|How the source determines if an existing user should be authenticated or a new user enrolled.|
|» user_path_template|body|string|false|none|
|» icon|body|string|false|none|
|» server_uri|body|string(uri)|true|none|
|» peer_certificate|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optionally verify the LDAP Server's Certificate against the CA Chain in this keypair.|
|» client_certificate|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Client certificate to authenticate against the LDAP Server's Certificate.|
|» bind_cn|body|string|false|none|
|» bind_password|body|string|false|none|
|» service_bind_method|body|object|false|Authentication method used for LDAP synchronization and writeback.|
|» start_tls|body|boolean|false|none|
|» sni|body|boolean|false|none|
|» base_dn|body|string|true|none|
|» additional_user_dn|body|string|false|Prepended to Base DN for User-queries.|
|» additional_group_dn|body|string|false|Prepended to Base DN for Group-queries.|
|» user_object_filter|body|string|false|Consider Objects matching this filter to be Users.|
|» group_object_filter|body|string|false|Consider Objects matching this filter to be Groups.|
|» group_membership_field|body|string|false|Field which contains members of a group.|
|» user_membership_attribute|body|string|false|Attribute which matches the value of `group_membership_field`.|
|» object_uniqueness_field|body|string|false|Field which contains a unique Identifier.|
|» password_login_update_internal_password|body|boolean|false|Update internal authentik password when login succeeds with LDAP|
|» sync_users|body|boolean|false|none|
|» sync_users_password|body|boolean|false|When a user changes their password, sync it back to LDAP. This can only be enabled on a single LDAP source.|
|» sync_groups|body|boolean|false|none|
|» sync_parent_group|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|none|
|» lookup_groups_from_user|body|boolean|false|Lookup group membership based on a user attribute instead of a group attribute. This allows nested group resolution on systems like FreeIPA and Active Directory|
|» delete_not_found_objects|body|boolean|false|Delete authentik users and groups which were previously supplied by this source, but are now missing from it.|
|» sync_outgoing_trigger_mode|body|object|false|When to trigger sync for outgoing providers|
|» sync_group_hierarchy|body|boolean|false|Sync group parentage/hierarchy from LDAP directories.|

|---|---|
|» policy_engine_mode|all|
|» policy_engine_mode|any|

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[SAMLSourceRequest](#schemasamlsourcerequest)|true|none|
|» name|body|string|true|Source's display Name.|
|» slug|body|string|true|Internal source name, used in URLs.|

|» issuer_override|body|string|false|Also known as Entity ID. Defaults to the Metadata URL.|

|» slo_url|body|string(uri) \| null|false|Optional URL if your IDP supports Single-Logout.|
|» allow_idp_initiated|body|boolean|false|Allows authentication flows initiated by the IdP. This can be a security risk, as no validation of the request ID is done.|
|» force_authn|body|boolean|false|When enabled, the IdP will re-authenticate the user even if a session exists.|
|» name_id_policy|body|object|false|NameID Policy sent to the IdP. Can be unset, in which case no Policy is sent.|
|» binding_type|body|[BindingTypeEnum](#schemabindingtypeenum)|false|none|

|» signature_algorithm|body|[SignatureAlgorithmEnum](#schemasignaturealgorithmenum)|false|none|

<h3 id="sourcessamlpartialupdate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|slug|path|string|true|none|
|body|body|[PatchedSAMLSourceRequest](#schemapatchedsamlsourcerequest)|false|none|
|» name|body|string|false|Source's display Name.|
|» slug|body|string|false|Internal source name, used in URLs.|
|» enabled|body|boolean|false|none|
|» promoted|body|boolean|false|When enabled, this source will be displayed as a prominent button on the login page, instead of a small icon.|
|» authentication_flow|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Flow to use when authenticating existing users.|
|» enrollment_flow|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Flow to use when enrolling new users.|
|» user_property_mappings|body|[string(uuid)]|false|none|
|» group_property_mappings|body|[string(uuid)]|false|none|
|» policy_engine_mode|body|[PolicyEngineMode](#schemapolicyenginemode)|false|none|

|» user_path_template|body|string|false|none|
|» icon|body|string|false|none|
|» group_matching_mode|body|object|false|How the source determines if an existing group should be used or a new group created.|
|» pre_authentication_flow|body|string(uuid)|false|Flow used before authentication.|
|» issuer_override|body|string|false|Also known as Entity ID. Defaults to the Metadata URL.|
|» sso_url|body|string(uri)|false|URL that the initial Login request is sent to.|
|» slo_url|body|string(uri) \| null|false|Optional URL if your IDP supports Single-Logout.|
|» allow_idp_initiated|body|boolean|false|Allows authentication flows initiated by the IdP. This can be a security risk, as no validation of the request ID is done.|
|» force_authn|body|boolean|false|When enabled, the IdP will re-authenticate the user even if a session exists.|
|» name_id_policy|body|object|false|NameID Policy sent to the IdP. Can be unset, in which case no Policy is sent.|
|» binding_type|body|[BindingTypeEnum](#schemabindingtypeenum)|false|none|
|» verification_kp|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|When selected, incoming assertion's Signatures will be validated against this certificate. To allow unsigned Requests, leave on default.|
|» signing_kp|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Keypair used to sign outgoing Responses going to the Identity Provider.|
|» digest_algorithm|body|[DigestAlgorithmEnum](#schemadigestalgorithmenum)|false|none|
|» signature_algorithm|body|[SignatureAlgorithmEnum](#schemasignaturealgorithmenum)|false|none|
|» temporary_user_delete_after|body|string|false|Time offset when temporary users should be deleted. This only applies if your IDP uses the NameID Format 'transient', and the user doesn't log out manually. (Format: hours=1;minutes=2;seconds=3).|
|» encryption_kp|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|When selected, incoming assertions are encrypted by the IdP using the public key of the encryption keypair. The assertion is decrypted by the SP using the the private key.|
|» signed_assertion|body|boolean|false|none|
|» signed_response|body|boolean|false|none|

<h3 id="stagesidentificationpartialupdate-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|stage_uuid|path|string(uuid)|true|A UUID string identifying this Identification Stage.|
|body|body|[PatchedIdentificationStageRequest](#schemapatchedidentificationstagerequest)|false|none|
|» name|body|string|false|none|
|» user_fields|body|[[UserFieldsEnum](#schemauserfieldsenum)]|false|Fields of the user object to match against. (Hold shift to select multiple options)|
|» password_stage|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|When set, shows a password field, instead of showing the password field as separate step.|
|» captcha_stage|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|When set, adds functionality exactly like a Captcha stage, but baked into the Identification stage.|
|» case_insensitive_matching|body|boolean|false|When enabled, user fields are matched regardless of their casing.|
|» show_matched_user|body|boolean|false|When a valid username/email has been entered, and this option is enabled, the user's username and avatar will be shown. Otherwise, the text that the user entered will be shown|
|» enrollment_flow|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional enrollment flow, which is linked at the bottom of the page.|
|» recovery_flow|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional recovery flow, which is linked at the bottom of the page.|
|» passwordless_flow|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|Optional passwordless flow, which is linked at the bottom of the page.|
|» sources|body|[string(uuid)]|false|Specify which sources should be shown.|
|» show_source_labels|body|boolean|false|none|
|» pretend_user_exists|body|boolean|false|When enabled, the stage will succeed and continue even when incorrect user info is entered.|
|» enable_remember_me|body|boolean|false|Show the user the 'Remember me on this device' toggle, allowing repeat users to skip straight to entering their password.|
|» webauthn_stage|body|string(uuid) \| null|false|When set, and conditional WebAuthn is available, allow the user to use their passkey as a first factor.|

|---|---|
|» user_fields|email|
|» user_fields|username|
|» user_fields|upn|

IdentificationStage Serializer

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|false|none|none|
|user_fields|[[UserFieldsEnum](#schemauserfieldsenum)]|false|none|Fields of the user object to match against. (Hold shift to select multiple options)|
|password_stage|string(uuid) \| null|false|none|When set, shows a password field, instead of showing the password field as separate step.|
|captcha_stage|string(uuid) \| null|false|none|When set, adds functionality exactly like a Captcha stage, but baked into the Identification stage.|
|case_insensitive_matching|boolean|false|none|When enabled, user fields are matched regardless of their casing.|
|show_matched_user|boolean|false|none|When a valid username/email has been entered, and this option is enabled, the user's username and avatar will be shown. Otherwise, the text that the user entered will be shown|
|enrollment_flow|string(uuid) \| null|false|none|Optional enrollment flow, which is linked at the bottom of the page.|
|recovery_flow|string(uuid) \| null|false|none|Optional recovery flow, which is linked at the bottom of the page.|
|passwordless_flow|string(uuid) \| null|false|none|Optional passwordless flow, which is linked at the bottom of the page.|
|sources|[string(uuid)]|false|none|Specify which sources should be shown.|
|show_source_labels|boolean|false|none|none|
|pretend_user_exists|boolean|false|none|When enabled, the stage will succeed and continue even when incorrect user info is entered.|
|enable_remember_me|boolean|false|none|Show the user the 'Remember me on this device' toggle, allowing repeat users to skip straight to entering their password.|
|webauthn_stage|string(uuid) \| null|false|none|When set, and conditional WebAuthn is available, allow the user to use their passkey as a first factor.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|user_fields|email|
|user_fields|username|
|user_fields|upn|

LDAPProvider Serializer

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|name|string|false|none|none|
|authentication_flow|string(uuid) \| null|false|none|Flow used for authentication when the associated application is accessed by an un-authenticated user.|
|authorization_flow|string(uuid)|false|none|Flow used when authorizing this provider.|
|invalidation_flow|string(uuid)|false|none|Flow used ending the session from a provider.|
|property_mappings|[string(uuid)]|false|none|none|

|certificate|string(uuid) \| null|false|none|none|
|tls_server_name|string|false|none|none|
|uid_start_number|integer|false|none|The start for uidNumbers, this number is added to the user.pk to make sure that the numbers aren't too low for POSIX users. Default is 2000 to ensure that we don't collide with local users uidNumber|
|gid_start_number|integer|false|none|The start for gidNumbers, this number is added to a number generated from the group.pk to make sure that the numbers aren't too low for POSIX groups. Default is 4000 to ensure that we don't collide with local groups or users primary groups gidNumber|
|search_mode|[LDAPAPIAccessMode](#schemaldapapiaccessmode)|false|none|none|
|bind_mode|[LDAPAPIAccessMode](#schemaldapapiaccessmode)|false|none|none|
|mfa_support|boolean|false|none|When enabled, code-based multi-factor authentication can be used by appending a semicolon and the TOTP code to the password. This should only be enabled if all users that will bind to this provider have a TOTP device configured, as otherwise a password may incorrectly be rejected if it contains a semicolon.|

SAMLProvider Serializer

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|pk|integer|true|read-only|none|
|name|string|true|none|none|
|authentication_flow|string(uuid) \| null|false|none|Flow used for authentication when the associated application is accessed by an un-authenticated user.|
|authorization_flow|string(uuid)|true|none|Flow used when authorizing this provider.|
|invalidation_flow|string(uuid)|true|none|Flow used ending the session from a provider.|
|property_mappings|[string(uuid)]|false|none|none|
|component|string|true|read-only|Get object component so that we know how to edit the object|
|assigned_application_slug|string \| null|true|read-only|Internal application name, used in URLs.|
|assigned_application_name|string \| null|true|read-only|Application's display Name.|
|assigned_backchannel_application_slug|string \| null|true|read-only|Internal application name, used in URLs.|
|assigned_backchannel_application_name|string \| null|true|read-only|Application's display Name.|
|verbose_name|string|true|read-only|Return object's verbose_name|
|verbose_name_plural|string|true|read-only|Return object's plural verbose_name|
|meta_model_name|string|true|read-only|Return internal model name|
|acs_url|string(uri)|true|none|none|
|sls_url|string(uri)|false|none|Single Logout Service URL where the logout response should be sent.|
|audience|string|false|none|Value of the audience restriction field of the assertion. When left empty, no audience restriction will be added.|
|issuer_override|string|false|none|Also known as EntityID. Providing a value overrides the default issuer generated by authentik.|
|assertion_valid_not_before|string|false|none|Assertion valid not before current time + this value (Format: hours=-1;minutes=-2;seconds=-3).|
|assertion_valid_not_on_or_after|string|false|none|Assertion not valid on or after current time + this value (Format: hours=1;minutes=2;seconds=3).|
|session_valid_not_on_or_after|string|false|none|Session not valid on or after current time + this value (Format: hours=1;minutes=2;seconds=3).|
|name_id_mapping|string(uuid) \| null|false|none|Configure how the NameID value will be created. When left empty, the NameIDPolicy of the incoming request will be considered|
|authn_context_class_ref_mapping|string(uuid) \| null|false|none|Configure how the AuthnContextClassRef value will be created. When left empty, the AuthnContextClassRef will be set based on which authentication methods the user used to authenticate.|
|digest_algorithm|[DigestAlgorithmEnum](#schemadigestalgorithmenum)|false|none|none|
|signature_algorithm|[SignatureAlgorithmEnum](#schemasignaturealgorithmenum)|false|none|none|
|signing_kp|string(uuid) \| null|false|none|Keypair used to sign outgoing Responses going to the Service Provider.|
|verification_kp|string(uuid) \| null|false|none|When selected, incoming assertion's Signatures will be validated against this certificate. To allow unsigned Requests, leave on default.|
|encryption_kp|string(uuid) \| null|false|none|When selected, incoming assertions are encrypted by the IdP using the public key of the encryption keypair. The assertion is decrypted by the SP using the the private key.|
|encryption_algorithm|object|false|none|Block cipher used to encrypt the assertion.|
|sign_assertion|boolean|false|none|none|
|sign_response|boolean|false|none|none|
|sign_logout_request|boolean|false|none|none|
|sign_logout_response|boolean|false|none|none|
|sp_binding|object|false|none|This determines how authentik sends the response back to the Service Provider.|
|sls_binding|object|false|none|This determines how authentik sends the logout response back to the Service Provider.|
|logout_method|object|false|none|Method to use for logout. Front-channel iframe loads all logout URLs simultaneously in hidden iframes. Front-channel native uses your active browser tab to send post requests and redirect to providers. Back-channel sends logout requests directly from the server without user interaction (requires POST SLS binding).|
|default_relay_state|string|false|none|Default relay_state value for IDP-initiated logins|
|default_name_id_policy|[SAMLNameIDPolicyEnum](#schemasamlnameidpolicyenum)|false|none|none|
|jwt_federation_providers|[integer]|false|none|OAuth2 providers which can exchange their JWTs for a SAML Response of this provider via token exchange.|
|url_download_metadata|string|true|read-only|Get metadata download URL|
|url_issuer|string|true|read-only|Get Issuer/EntityID URL|
|url_unified|string|true|read-only|Get unified SAML endpoint URL (handles SSO and SLO)|
|url_unified_init|string|true|read-only|Get IdP-initiated SAML URL|
|url_sso_post|string|true|read-only|Get SSO Post URL|
|url_sso_redirect|string|true|read-only|Get SSO Redirect URL|
|url_sso_init|string|true|read-only|Get SSO IDP-Initiated URL|
|url_slo_post|string|true|read-only|Get SLO POST URL|
|url_slo_redirect|string|true|read-only|Get SLO redirect URL|
